title: Advanced Go Concurrency Patterns
content:
Concurrency is one of Go's greatest strengths. Go makes it easy to write concurrent programs using goroutines and channels.

In this article, we dive deep into:
- Understanding goroutines and how they differ from threads
- Channels and channel patterns
- Synchronization primitives (mutexes, semaphores)
- Common concurrency pitfalls and how to avoid them
- Real-world examples of concurrent Go applications

Mastering concurrency in Go will help you write efficient, high-performance applications.
